why: observed direction: QGAN-LLM > Classical GAN-LLM; hypothesis expects: QGAN-LLM < Classical GAN-LLM
equivalence (fid): diff = 13.23, 90% CI [8.148, 18.31] vs +/-12.17 (0.1 x |reference mean| (121.677)) -> not shown (p_TOST = 0.641)
paired by seed (fid): n = 10, mean diff = 13.23, 95% CI [6.453, 20], p = 0.002; the sign of the seed-wise difference is the same in 10 of 10 seeds (rule: at least 8): rule met

H2_forecast_rmse.headline: H2 (QGAN RMSE lower than classical): SUPPORTED (confirmatory) -- observed QGAN-LLM < Classical GAN-LLM, p=0.047.
why: observed direction: QGAN-LLM < Classical GAN-LLM; hypothesis expects: QGAN-LLM < Classical GAN-LLM
equivalence (rmse): diff = -5.495e-05, 90% CI [-9.956e-05, -1.033e-05] vs +/-2.885e-06 (0.02 x persistence RMSE (0.000144259)) -> not shown (p_TOST = 0.971)
paired by seed (rmse): n = 10, mean diff = -5.495e-05, 95% CI [-9.419e-05, -1.57e-05], p = 0.011; the sign of the seed-wise difference is the same in 9 of 10 seeds (rule: at least 8): rule met
Holm-adjusted p = 0.175 >= 0.05

H3_attack_success_qgan_vs_classical.headline: H3 (QGAN ASR lower than classical): CONTRADICTED (confirmatory) -- observed QGAN-LLM > Classical GAN-LLM, p=0.044.
why: observed direction: QGAN-LLM > Classical GAN-LLM; hypothesis expects: QGAN-LLM < Classical GAN-LLM
equivalence (asr): diff = 18.25, 90% CI [3.665, 32.83] vs +/-5 (5 (absolute)) -> not shown (p_TOST = 0.934)
paired by seed (asr): n = 10, mean diff = 18.25, 95% CI [7.771, 28.73], p = 0.003; the sign of the seed-wise difference is the same in 10 of 10 seeds (rule: at least 8): rule met
Holm-adjusted p = 0.175 >= 0.05
